name: Oracle of the Oak
text: The rustling oak speaks. Reveal every hex within 3 of any target, anywhere on the map.
flavor: The oak at Dodona rustles, and the priests listen.

name: Aegis of the Polis
text: Target your shrine: +2 Ward, lift any eclipse, and a new priest rises there.
flavor: The goddess stands on the wall of the city.

name: Gift of the Grain
text: For 3 turns your Faith income is x1.4, and every settlement you control gains +1 population.
flavor: She gives the grain, and every hearth is warm.

name: Thunderbolt
text: Miracle. Strike a revealed settlement: rival priests there are scattered back to their nearest shrine, 2 rival followers fall silent (become unaffiliated) and 2 mortals turn to you.
flavor: The Cyclopes made it; Zeus throws it.

name: Flight of the Ravens
text: Two ravens fly out and return: reveal the 2 nearest hidden settlements and the land around them.
flavor: Thought and Memory fly out at dawn.

name: Rune-Carved Hall
text: Raise a shrine at a revealed settlement within 4 hexes of your land for 55% of the cost, even with no followers there.
flavor: The runes are cut, and the hall stands.

name: Rain and Sunshine
text: For 3 turns gain +1 Faith per settlement you control, and every settlement you control gains +1 population now.
flavor: Rain and sun from the lord of the Vanir.

name: Hammer of Thunder
text: Miracle. Strike a rival shrine within 4 hexes of your shrines or priests: -1 Ward and it is eclipsed for 2 turns. The hammer returns.
flavor: The hammer returns to the hand that threw it.

name: Barque of Re
inspiredBy: Re's solar bark crossing the sky
text: The sun's boat sails across the whole sky: reveal a 3-row band across the entire map through the target, and your Faith income is x1.1 for 2 turns.
flavor: The bark of millions of years sails the sky.

name: Throne of Isis
text: A new priest rises at your target shrine and all your priests preach with double strength for 2 turns.
flavor: She is the throne, and the throne protects.

name: Osiris Garden
text: Target a settlement where you have followers: +3 population who follow you, and +4 Faith now.
flavor: Grain sprouts from the god who rose again.

name: Feather of Maat
text: Miracle. Weigh a revealed settlement: 25% of each rival's followers there (rounded up) turn to you.
flavor: The heart is weighed against the feather.

name: Crossing of Utu
inspiredBy: Utu/Šamaš's daily path across the sky
flavor: He leaves his chamber at dawn and looks down on every road.
text: Reveal a 3-row band 15 hexes wide through the target, and every waterside hex within 3 of it. Utu, who sees all, grants 1 Favor.

name: Sages of Eridu
inspiredBy: The apkallu sages of Enki, who came from Eridu
flavor: Seven came up from the water and taught the cities their crafts.
text: A Seer priest rises at your shrine, and that shrine teaches 50% harder for 3 turns.

name: Wells of the Abzu
inspiredBy: Enki's fresh-water deep beneath the earth
flavor: Sweet water rises in the wells of every town on the canal.
text: Target a town with your followers: it and up to 4 of your waterside towns within 3 hexes gain +1 population and +2 prosperity; +1 Faith per town blessed.

name: Star of Inanna
flavor: The star stands over the gate, and the gate opens to her.
text: Miracle. At a contested town where you have followers, a priest or territory, 4 followers of the strongest rival turn to you.

name: Omens of the Morrígan
flavor: She tells of the battle before it is fought.
text: Reveal the nearest hidden town, every rival priest within 4 hexes of your shrines, and coming weather within 6 hexes for 4 turns.

name: Assembly of Lugh
inspiredBy: Lugh's arrival at the assembly of Tara
flavor: Every art is welcome at the gathering.
text: At your shrine: +1 Ward and a new priest joins the gathering (an Emissary, or the calling you choose; if you choose one, every priest there takes it), and your followers there are 40% harder to convert for 3 turns.

name: Cauldron of Plenty
flavor: The cauldron is passed down the hall and comes back full.
text: Up to 4 towns you control gain +1 population and +2 prosperity, and you gain 4 Faith.

name: The Sovereignty Challenge
inspiredBy: The Morrígan and the sovereignty of the land
flavor: The land chooses who holds it; she asks it again.
text: Miracle. At a town with rival followers within 3 of your shrines or priests, your pressure there is +1.6 for 3 turns. Rivals can still answer it.

name: Breath of Quetzalcoatl
flavor: The wind runs ahead and tells the rain where to fall.
text: Near the known world: reveal a 2-row swath 11 hexes wide through the target, and see coming weather within 5 hexes for 4 turns.

name: Gardens of Chalchiuhtlicue
flavor: Mud from the lake, reeds for the fence, and a field where there was water.
text: Raise a shrine at a revealed waterside town within 4 of your land for 55% of the cost, even with no followers there; that town grows faster for 6 turns (+2 prosperity now).

name: Rains of Tlaloc
flavor: The jars of the rain are opened over the thirsty fields.
text: Your towns within 2 hexes of the target gain +3 prosperity and +1 population (at most 4), any drought over them breaks, and you gain 0.5 Faith per town.

name: Zenith of Tonatiuh
inspiredBy: Tonatiuh, the sun at its height
flavor: At noon there are no shadows to hide in.
text: Miracle. At a contested town where you have presence, for 3 turns your pressure there doubles and every rival's falls by 30%.

name: Omens of Hatti
inspiredBy: The Sun goddess of Arinna and the state cult of Hatti
flavor: The signs are read at every gate before the gate is opened.
text: Reveal the 2 nearest hidden towns, and see coming weather within 8 hexes of your shrines for 3 turns.

name: Gates of Arinna
inspiredBy: The stone gates and sanctuaries of Hattusa
flavor: Stone on stone, so close a blade will not go between.
text: Your shrine: +2 Ward (up to 6), its eclipse lifts, and for 4 turns it loses 1 less Ward to any hit.

name: Return of Telipinu
inspiredBy: Telipinu's return and the restoring of growth
flavor: He came home, and the fields remembered how to grow.
text: Target your town: it regains up to 3 lost population (never above its peak) and +4 prosperity; your Faith income is ×1.25 for 2 turns.

name: Tempest of Tarḫunna
flavor: He overcomes; that is what his name means.
text: Miracle. A rival shrine within 4 of your shrines or priests: -1 Ward and eclipsed for 3 turns. Sanctuaries and Wardens blunt it.

name: River Mirror
inspiredBy: Ọ̀ṣun and the river through her grove
flavor: Look into the river and see where it has been.
text: Near the known world: reveal every waterside hex within 4 of the target and the land within 1.

name: Hands of Creation
flavor: The land was poured out by hand, and by hand it is mended.
text: Your shrine's eclipse lifts; it and your shrines within 3 gain +1 Ward (up to 5); its town regains 1 lost population and feels safe again, and a new priest is shaped there.

name: Iron Roads
flavor: Open the road and the market comes down it.
text: Gain 2 Faith per active pilgrim route now; for 3 turns your routes count double and your priests on them walk 1 further.

name: Thunder of Ṣàngó
flavor: The stone falls from the cloud; the judgment is quick.
text: Miracle. A rival shrine within 3 of your shrines or priests: -1 Ward, eclipsed 1 turn, and 1 rival follower there turns to you. A Sanctuary turns the stone aside.

name: Light of Amaterasu
flavor: The mirror catches the light and throws it into the valley.
text: Near the known world: reveal radius 3; your shrines in that light shed their eclipses; see coming weather there for 2 turns.

name: Shrine of the Land
flavor: A gate at the edge of the field says: this land is held.
text: Raise a shrine for 75% cost at a revealed town within 3 hexes of a town you control.

name: Inari's Harvest
flavor: The paddies are full to the dikes.
text: Up to 5 of your towns on grassland or plains gain +1 population and +2 prosperity; your Faith income is ×1.3 for 2 turns.

name: Storm of Susanoo
inspiredBy: Susanoo, linked with wind and rain
flavor: The sky darkens over a single valley, and everyone sees it coming.
text: Miracle. A storm gathers over a rival shrine within 4 of your shrines or priests and breaks next round: -2 Ward, eclipsed 2 turns. The owner sees it coming and can answer.

name: Uṣas's First Dawn
flavor: She uncovers the dark like a woman uncovering her face.
text: Near the known world: reveal radius 3, see coming weather within 4 for 3 turns, and your next Read Omens this turn or next is free.

name: Agni's Fire
inspiredBy: Agni, the sacrificial fire and messenger of the gods
flavor: The fire is carried east to the offering altar and burns brighter there.
text: Your shrine: +1 Ward, a priest is ordained from its fire, and your priests there preach 50% harder for 3 turns.

name: Order of Varuṇa
flavor: He measures the earth with the sun as with a rod.
text: For 3 turns your followers within 2 hexes of the target are 60% harder to convert; those towns trust you a little more, and you gain 1 Faith per town.

name: Indra's Rainstorm
flavor: The cloud bursts over the fort, and its walls run with water.
text: Miracle. At a town with rival followers within 3 of your shrines or priests: 3 rival followers fall silent, 1 mortal turns to you and your pressure there is +1.2 for 2 turns. Warded towns resist.
